title: Default, Cure and Referral Terms Matrix — Property Charge Advance Repayment
content:
For each Property Charge Advance Repayment arrangement, the matrix below sets the number of missed installments that defaults the arrangement, the cure period after a default, the deadline for the default notice, the period after a referred default during which no new arrangement is offered, where an unresolved arrangement is referred, whether an active At-Risk Extension holds off referral, and whether the arrangement is reported to HUD on a HECM loan.

| Arrangement | Missed installments that default it | Cure period after default (calendar days) | Default notice sent within (calendar days after default) | No new arrangement offered for (months after a referred default) | Referred to | Active extension holds off referral | Reported to HUD on a HECM loan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lump-Sum Repayment | 0 (no installments) | 0 | 5 | 24 | Property Charge Default maturity case | No | Yes |
| Repayment Plan - 12 Months | 2 | 30 | 5 | 24 | Property Charge Default maturity case | No | Yes |
| Repayment Plan - 24 Months | 2 | 30 | 5 | 24 | Property Charge Default maturity case | No | Yes |
| Repayment Plan - 36 Months | 2 | 30 | 5 | 24 | Property Charge Default maturity case | No | Yes |
| Repayment Plan - 60 Months | 3 | 30 | 5 | 24 | Property Charge Default maturity case | No | Yes |
| At-Risk Extension | 0 (no installments) | 0 | 5 | 24 | Property Charge Default maturity case | Yes | Yes |

## Notes to the matrix

1. Missed installments are counted over the life of the arrangement. A count of 0 marks an arrangement without installments, which has nothing to miss.
2. Repayment Plan - 60 Months is the one arrangement that defaults on the third missed installment; each of the other three Repayment Plan arrangements defaults on the second.
3. The cure period is counted in calendar days after the default; a figure of 0 appears only where no installment default can occur.
4. Only the At-Risk Extension has a "Yes" in the holds-off-referral column.
5. The HUD reporting term applies to arrangements on a HECM loan, where the arrangement is reported to HUD as a property charge loss mitigation option.

### Hypothetical count

Under a hypothetical Repayment Plan - 36 Months arrangement with one missed installment on record, the arrangement has not defaulted; a second missed installment, wherever it falls in the term, reaches the figure of 2. Under a hypothetical Repayment Plan - 60 Months arrangement the same two missed installments stay below that plan's figure of 3.
